newsitem.title: FINLAND: OUTOKUMPU SELLS ZINC CARGO SHIP TO ENGSHIP.
newsitem.headline: OUTOKUMPU SELLS ZINC CARGO SHIP TO ENGSHIP.

text.p: Finnish metals and mining group Outokumpu Oy said in a statement on Friday it had sold its M/S Outokumpu cargo ship to Finnish shipping company Rederi Ab Engship for an undisclosed sum.

"Owing to the expansion of Outokumpu's zinc plant at Kokkola the amount of zinc to be transported will increase, and transport by one ship from the Kokkola harbour will not be sufficient any more," it said, adding the divestment marked a step in the drive to focus on core businesses, it said.
Outokumpu said an unnamed company would take care of weekly transport by four ships.
